subject: Renewal planning — GreenMart capacity signal and competitive benchmark
messages:
From: Tim Walsh <tim.walsh@greenmart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Li <anna.li@procurement.greenmart.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window & a quick ask on performance validation

Sean —

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick summary from my side: GreenMart's renewal with Redwood comes up in August, and we're getting pressure from an incumbent vendor that claims they can halve our per-token cost if we move. Before we go down negotiating pricing with procurement, ops wants a concise bake-off plan that proves Redwood's latency and scaling for our busiest flows (search suggestions + checkout personalization).

Can you do the following by next week?
- A short scope doc for a 2-week side-by-side (what we need from GreenMart, what Redwood will deliver)
- Latency and throughput targets you can guarantee for our 95th percentile traffic spikes
- A proposed short-term concession on contract terms if we show matching performance (thinking 6–9 month bridge)

I'm copying Anna (procurement) who will need details on SOW and terms.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — the alternate vendor is already in our SOW queue.

Thanks,
Tim
Tim Walsh
Head of Core Platform — GreenMart

Attachment: greenmart_bakeoff_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tim Walsh <tim.walsh@greenmart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window & a quick ask on performance validation

Tim —

Thanks for the heads up. We're confident we can run a compact, appliance-style side-by-side that targets your two busiest flows and gives you apples-to-apples telemetry. Ben and Marissa are on this thread to scope the technical plan and the commercial bridge respectively.

High level commitment from Redwood:
- We'll deliver a 2-week side-by-side test environment (dedicated pool) covering search-suggestions and checkout personalization flows.
- Target SLA for the test: 95th percentile latency <= 220ms for search-suggestions at your projected spike QPS, and <= 300ms for checkout personalization. We'll provide raw latency histograms and token-level cost estimates.
- If test results are within 10% of the incumbent on both latency and cost, Redwood will offer a 9-month bridge amendment with a 12% rebate applied to overage units for that period (terms draft to follow).

Ben — can you propose the minimal footprint (GPU types, concurrency, sample payloads) and timeline? Marissa — I'll need a topline term we can sign quickly if results are good.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Tim Walsh <tim.walsh@greenmart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window & a quick ask on performance validation

Team —

Scope notes (draft):
- Two test flows: (1) Search-suggestions (avg payload 120 tokens, 30ms model compute per request), (2) Checkout personalization (avg 220 tokens, 80ms compute).
- Proposed test infra: 4x A10 GPUs in a dedicated pool, pinned model variant (quantized) that we will serve for both vendors; Redis prefix caching for hot keys. Continuous load generator to simulate 95th/99th percentile spikes.
- Deliverables: per-request latency distributions, token counts, cost-per-1M-tokens estimate, KV cache hit rate, ephemeral KV snapshot, automated replay script.
- Timeline: provision within 48 hours of greenlight; ramp and run over 14 calendar days.

I'll attach the test harness and the first-run benchmark we ran for a customer with similar profile.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment: bench_results_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Anna Li <anna.li@procurement.greenmart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Tim Walsh <tim.walsh@greenmart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window & a quick ask on performance validation

Thanks — a couple procurement items to note up front so your commercial team can prepare: 
- We need a one-page SOW and an addendum template for the bridge (legal will need it for initial review).
- If Redwood is asking for dedicated infra during the test, procurement would like clarity on data handling and logging retention (SOC 2 controls, audit logs).
- Pricing question: what are the billing deltas during test? Are test tokens billed at standard rates or marked as trial?

Marissa — can you prepare the SOW and a short list of acceptable logging/retention terms? We'll try to fast-track legal on our side but want to avoid surprises.

Anna
Anna Li
Senior Procurement Manager — GreenMart

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@procurement.greenmart.com>, Tim Walsh <tim.walsh@greenmart.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window & a quick ask on performance validation

Anna / Tim —

Attached is a short commercial package (proposed_terms_redwood_v1.docx):
- 9-month bridge amendment draft (applies if side-by-side meets agreed targets). Includes a 12% rebate on overage units during bridge, and a one-time credit equal to 2 weeks of average monthly usage to offset testing costs.
- Data handling: Redwood will serve the side-by-side from a Dedicated pool in our US region; logs retained 90 days by default with ability to extend via add-on. SOC 2 scoping language included.
- Billing: Test usage will be billed at standard rates but the one-time credit will be applied after completion if we meet success criteria. We can also mark the test environment as "trial" in billing so it doesn't trigger overage alerts.

Proposed next steps:
1) GreenMart confirms test window (target start: 6/9) and provides sample payloads and projected spike QPS.
2) Redwood provisions infra and shares replay script + monitoring dashboards.
3) Run 14-day test and produce results; if targets met, sign the bridge and apply credit/rebate.

I'll drop the SOW and terms link into the HubSpot deal (see link) and keep legal standing by.

Happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow if you want to walk through the language.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_terms_redwood_v1.docx
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/GreenMart-44
